title: Smart Decisions: A Structured Approach to Decision Analysis Using MCDA (Wiley Series in Op
description: Explore the fundamentals of Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis with help from Excel® and R In Smart Decisions: A Structured Approach to Decision Analysis using MCDA , a distinguished team of decision-making specialists delivers a comprehensive and insightful exploration of the fundamentals of Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis methods. The book offers guidance on modeling decision problems using some of the most powerful methods in operations research. Each chapter introduces a core MCDA method and guides the reader through a step-by-step approach to the implementation of the method using Microsoft® Excel® and then using R, a popular analytical language. The book also includes: A thorough, step-by-step guide to Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis methods and the application of these methods in Microsoft Excel and R Extensive illustrations, R code, and software screenshots to aid the reader’s understanding of the concepts discussed within A starter’s guide to Excel and R programming Perfect for graduate students in MBA programs and business schools, Smart Decisions: A Structured Approach to Decision Analysis Using MCDA is also an ideal resource for practitioners who apply MCDA in business, finance, applied mathematics, and engineering.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_5"]', '#CardInstance7w-0TCA_dFWzltvoo5pgCQ')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_5',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);he

title: Smart Decisions: The Art of Strategic Thinking for the Decision Making Process
description: Today's world is complex and getting more so each day. Huge multinational corporations, international crisis and fast breaking events require most people to make decisions on a daily basis without the tools to understand the long term impact that today's decision might create. Because most people have never really been trained in how to make important complex decisions most people rely on experience, and 'gut reaction' which is okay for many decisions, but not okay for decision that will have meaningful impact on organizations and individual. Decision makers need to develop the art and science of strategic decision making. Here, Professor Thomas Martin explains the need for decision makers to modify their thinking about how they deal with acquiring and analyzing information in each of the decision-making process steps. This approach requiring thinking modification will lengthen the process, make it more complex, and to some more arduous, but the comprehensiveness of the new thinking approach should lead to improved and more effective decision making. In this book, Dr. Martin presents a thinking modification framework that asserts that in the decision-making process, there are three situational states — a current state, future state, and a transitional state that one must deliberate in finding a solution. For each of these situational states, Martin develops an identical five-step process to determine the best decision to make. title: Smart Decisions: Using Data in Decision-Making
description: The book "Smart Decisions: Using Data in Decision-Making" explores the importance of decision-making across various aspects of life, from personal choices to business strategies. With technological advances and the abundance of available data, it has become essential to understand how to use this information to make smart, informed decisions. The text highlights the intersection between data and decisions, providing valuable insights on how to make the most of the resources available in the digital age. Additionally, it addresses the crucial role of the brain in the decision-making process, emphasizing the influence of neurotransmitters, emotions, and social contexts. The book also discusses the importance of collecting relevant information, evaluating alternatives, and defining objectives when making decisions. description: Praise for Smart Money Decisions "If you need to negotiate anything . . . from a pay increase to buying or selling a house-this book covers all the bases. This groundbreaking book gives you the necessary tools to think through financial issues practically and avoid costly blunders. A renowned expert in the field of decision-making and negotiation, Max Bazerman illustrates both how and why we make the decisions we do. title: Smart Decisions in Complex Systems
description: Faced with ever-increasing complexity on a daily basis, the decision-makers of today are struggling to find the appropriate models, methods and tools to face the issues arising in complex systems across all levels of global operations. Having, in the past, resorted to outdated approaches which limit problem-solving to linear world views, we must now capitalize on complexities in order to succeed and progress in our society. This book provides a guide to harnessing the wealth inherent to complex systems. It organizes the transition to complex decision-making in all business spheres while providing many examples in various application domains. title: Smart Decisions: Dieciséis conversaciones sobre cómo decidimos (Spanish Edition)
description: Smart Decisions nace de las conversaciones mantenidas por el periodista Martín Expósito con dieciséis profesionales de primer nivel procedentes del mundo de la empresa, la comunicación, la tecnología, el liderazgo, la defensa, la cultura y la innovación. A partir de sus experiencias, el autor construye una reflexión práctica y profundamente humana sobre la toma de decisiones. Todos decidimos cada día. Algunas decisiones apenas tienen consecuencias. Otras cambian una empresa, una carrera profesional o incluso una vida. Pero ¿qué ocurre cuando no existe toda la información? ¿Qué papel juegan la intuición, la experiencia, los datos o la cultura? ¿Cómo afrontan la incertidumbre quienes deben decidir bajo presión? Este no es un libro de fórmulas mágicas. Es un libro para reflexionar acerca de cómo se toman las decisiones con datos, preguntando a tu entorno, desde la intuición... title: Smart Decisions & Best Results: Decision science for everyday business
description: Every business decision shouldn't be a strategy problem. The gap sits underneath: how you interpret information, how you frame a situation, how a decision forms before you've consciously chosen anything. Pricing that looks right on paper falls apart in the room. Hiring gets delayed despite a clear need. None of it is a flaw. It's how the brain is built to operate, fast and pattern-driven, long before the slower, deliberate thinking catches up. Smart Decisions & Best Results connects three fields rarely put in the same room: decision science, communication, and operational discipline.
